doubts.claim_under_doubt: the header means uv never consults a CWD .python-version, on any uv version
doubts.disproof_attempt: Only pins that requires-python >=3.11 rejects were tested (2.6, 3.9); a compatible pin might still be honoured.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Poisoned-CWD case with a compatible-but-uninstallable pin. RESOLVED: probed 3.99 with UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never on uv 0.11.9 and 0.12.19: the headed hook exits 0 silently; the headerless control errors on 0.11.9. Test pin changed to 3.99.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: no behavioural change; both layers stay
doubts.disproof_attempt: uv might warn that --no-project is ignored for a script with inline metadata, adding stderr noise to every hook and to exit-2 block reasons.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Capture stderr on CI's uv and 0.11. RESOLVED: stderr is empty on 0.11.9 and 0.12.19; measured and recorded in docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md.

doubts.disproof_attempt: Only warm runs were measured; 12 plugins start run_if_cache_ready at once on a cold cache.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Cold-cache 12-way measurement. RESOLVED: 2.3 s wall vs 0.5 s for the old command, all 12 exit 0, inside the 5 s / 10 s repair windows; recorded in the docs.

doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Strip them. RESOLVED: the probe env strips UV_*, CLAUDE*, SHIPWRIGHT_* and VIRTUAL_ENV, and sets UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: every hook entry point is isolated
doubts.disproof_attempt: Three bash hooks never go through uv and look up python3 on PATH.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Reword to uv-run entry points. RESOLVED in the docs, and recorded as out of scope in the spec.
